background: Wells Fargo & Company is the holding company of one of the four largest US banks, with consumer banking and lending, commercial banking, corporate and investment banking and wealth management, and a long regulatory remediation behind it.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, the group was upgraded by one notch by one of the three on 29 Sep 2026. Capital is the weak spot: CET1 of 10.3% is in the bottom quarter of US banks, and both CET1 and leverage have fallen 0.9 points since 30 Jun 2025, though leverage of 5.8% still sits at the peer median. Liquidity is adequate, with LCR of 119% at the median and broadly flat. The recent news is the upgrade itself; the latest flagged headline, on 1 Oct 2026, concerns its analysts' views on oil stocks and says nothing about its own credit.
